generator: hand-authored probes + artifacts generated through serializeDcr itself (p3-1); cli-gated-run.yaml minted by the p3-3 CLI path
policy: Golden DCR artifact documents (ADR 0046, ruling D17) backing the round-trip, byte-stability, and refusal pins. Synthetic, value-free data only (ADR 0025): no dataset cell values, no SQL, no timestamps, no sensitive paths — pinned by scan tests in packages/pipeline/src/dcr-build.test.ts. Canonical fixtures satisfy text === serializeDcr(parseDcr(text)); gated-run-alternate.yaml is the deliberate non-canonical rendering pinned to canonicalize to gated-run.yaml; the refuses-* fixtures are negative probes (parse must fail with exactly the pinned code). The D19-OQ-4 bounding-disclosure keys (newCategoriesBounded / vanishedCategoriesBounded, p3-1b) are additive-optional: present exactly when a top-k payload hit its M6 bound, absent otherwise. Regenerate the sha256 values deliberately with any fixture change.

files.name: bounded-topk.yaml
files.description: The D19-OQ-4 bounding disclosure (p3-1b): a categorical delta whose candidate-side top-k hit its M6 bound carries newCategoriesBounded: true while the unbounded base side stays absent — absence is meaning, visible in one block. Generated through serializeDcr itself, so canonical: true is honest by construction

files.name: gated-run-alternate.yaml
files.description: Deliberately non-canonical rendering of gated-run.yaml (JSON form, shuffled key order, 1-space indent): parses to the same AST and canonicalizes byte-for-byte to it (the architecture-example discipline)

files.name: gated-run.yaml
files.description: Full canonical artifact off a synthetic gated run: schema-drift findings (type-cross-family, column-added, nullability), numeric + categorical distribution deltas, a keyed rowDiff with bounded anchor-free samples, two value-free validate verdicts, and P2-derived lineage. Generated through serializeDcr itself, so canonical: true is honest by construction

files.name: cli-gated-run.yaml
files.description: p3-3: the committed golden artifact the REAL CLI path writes end-to-end (execute the fixtures/pipeline/cli_dcr_gated.yaml gated run, derive both version references via the p3-2 function, buildDcrArtifact, serializeDcr) — apps/cli/src/dcr.integration.test.ts pins CLI bytes == serializer bytes == this file, plus run-to-run stability. Generated through serializeDcr itself, so canonical: true is honest by construction

files.name: minimal.yaml
files.description: The smallest legal artifact: stamped sides (node and export materialization spellings), an empty deltas block, and the canonical privacyFindings disclosure
